segments.text: The money you lose on a job is rarely the money you argued about. It is the detail nobody captured.
A reading not taken. A pre-existing crack not photographed. A room entered, but never scoped.
You cannot bill what you cannot evidence, and you cannot defend what you did not record.
RestoreAssist removes the guesswork at the point it costs you. On site, in the moment, while the damage is still in front of you.
It prompts for what this job type needs, flags what is missing before you leave, and builds the scope from what you actually recorded.
More complete capture means more defensible billing, and fewer variations you quietly write off.
It works in the other direction too. The record that supports an invoice is the same record that shows a hazard was identified and managed.
